native_connection_and_regression.scope: Optional criterion on original Simulation with scripted researcher/corpus/critic; default native evaluator, loss, original objective and content staging checks. Not fresh model inference or a whole-repository regression.

previously_skipped_isolated_runtime_regr.scope: Same three existing native relaxation cases, rerun with local Docker access; scripted scientist/corpus, actual isolated code. Not three independent science replications.

historical_input_staging.scope: Exact original-source checkpoint reads and current instrument's complete-input preflight. Not critic score, token-capacity certification, actual-model readiness, a review intervention or new loss optimization.

invariants: Existing native measurements and run/system identity cannot be overwritten by the trusted optional extension.
Fixed content/rubric/model/critic has the same request across policy labels and administrative source IDs or budgets.
Raw UTF8 precedes dispatch; HTTP raw precedes interpretation; cold status/rating/usage reconstruction checks both.
Inference lease precedes POST intent; a busy lease creates no false unknown physical dispatch.
Unknown completion stops subsequent model dispatch and the next native world; missing/invalid scores remain unavailable.
Zero accepted decisions is an empty measured sum, without a hidden activity or adoption veto.
Native checkpoint evidence survives a later measurement failure; cached ratings are not additional physical replies.
